about: Receiving-water names of reports that sat on no water page (untraced-outfall water fixes, 2026-11-28; research/registry/untraced-outfall-waters-2026-11-28.csv): North Tonawanda's overflow reports (NY0026280, NY DEC Sewage Pollution Right to Know) name Sawyer Creek, which the USGS NHD high-resolution flowlines carry (GNIS 942105) 73 m from the reports' point, for python -m ingest.waters_from_nhd --names <this file> --state NY. Points are the reports' own.
